projects.name: W Hotel And Residences -Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 300-key hotel in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah.

The hotel will feature a total of 300 rooms and suites, all offering stunning, unobstructed views of the sea. The design of the property includes various spaces such as the Living Room, WET deck, W Lounge, AWAY Spa, and FIT fitness center, providing guests with a range of amenities and recreational options. Additionally, the resort is anticipated to house three restaurants and offer retail space for added convenience and enjoyment.

projects.name: Oceanz by DANUBE - Dubai Maritime City
projects.description: The project involves the construction of a waterfront development named Oceanz situated at the forefront of Dubai Maritime City comprising three towers, each structure featuring a Basement, ground floor, 6 parking floors and 44 additional floors. It features 1,250 residential units including studio apartments, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom apartments and a few retail stores. Positioned at the prime front line of Dubai Maritime City, these residences bear the prestigious Tonino Lamborghini branding. The amenities here cater to a luxurious lifestyle, including a Kids' Play Area, health club, sauna and spa, outdoor cinema, jogging track, yoga center, and an on-call resident doctor available 24/7. Parents will appreciate the Kids Day Care service with trained nannies for supervision, while outdoor enthusiasts can enjoy outdoor cabanas with BBQ areas, mini golf, a paddle tennis court, and a Cricket Pitch. Other conveniences include a beauty salon, business center, prayer room, and Wi-Fi-enabled waiting lounges. Oceanz by DANUBE - Dubai Maritime City is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 681.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Danube Properties,Tonino Lamborghini. Llc; MEP contractor City Compass Electro-Mechanical Works Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Reem Hills - Phase 3
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of phase 3 of Reem Hills located on Abu Dhabi's Al Reem Island. The project offering an array of housing options including 3-bedroom townhouses, 4-bedroom twin villas, and spacious 4-7 bedroom standalone villas. These waterfront homes redefine luxury living with their inspiring designs and aesthetics, seamlessly blending nature and modernity to create an atmosphere of elegance and sophistication.

Phase three of this development comprises five distinct clusters: Park Valley, North Bay, Coast Way, Garden Homes, and Beach Bay. Each of these clusters is designed to provide residents with enhanced comfort, elegance, indulgence, and an aesthetic lifestyle. The architecture of these homes is unparalleled

The development also offers a range of private facilities, including courtyards and swimming pools, ensuring residents experience a truly exceptional and comfortable living environment. Premium amenities such as sports facilities, recreational areas, entertainment options, educational institutions, leisure spaces, and more are all within reach, making this a truly wonderful and exceptional place to live.

The project offers lush green parks, a kids' play area, a gym, hotels, indoor parking, outdoor sitting areas, a shopping mall, a promising return on investment, beach access, hospitals, a jogging track, and a tranquil community.

Reem Hills - Phase 3 is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 70.0 million, at concept. Developed by Q Holding (Al Qudra Holding Pjsc). No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Samana Portofino - Dubai Production City
projects.description:
The project encompasses the construction of a residential building situated in Dubai Production City. The project will spread over an area of 24,108 sq meters comprising a basement level, ground floor, and 11 additional floors. This building offers a total of 226 units, featuring a mix of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom configurations. Notably, each unit includes a private pool on the balcony, fully equipped kitchens, and is equipped with a smart home system.

All bedrooms within the units are full-ensuite, and residents can enjoy amenities like a surfing board, basketball court, leisure pool deck, valet parking, concierge services, outdoor cinema, jogging track, and a health club with sauna and steam room. The indoor and outdoor gym is fully equipped, and each apartment comes with one designated parking spot.

The project represents the essence of Italian comune-style architecture, seamlessly combining elements such as water features, a vibrant town lifestyle, opulent living spaces, and private pools within the apartments.

Samana Portofino - Dubai Production City is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 68.1 million, at under construction (5.0 percent complete). Developed by Samana Developers. Lead consultant Arec Engineering Consultant; MEP consultant Arec Engineering Consultant. Main contractor Italtech Contracting Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Nima - The Valley by Emaar
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a residential development named Nima at The Valley by Emaar comprising 520 units. The project will offer 3 & 4-bedroom townhouses, combining contemporary luxury with the beauty of nature in a harmonious fusion.

Strategically located on the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Nima is situated between the two iconic Emirates, Dubai and Al Ain. Its proximity to the Sevens Stadium and convenient access to key areas of Dubai ensure that residents can lead an enriching and active life. This development holds a prime spot within the picturesque community, gracefully positioned between The Valley Gate and The Pavilion.

The development has meticulously crafted an outstanding array of family-oriented amenities, setting a new benchmark in the region. Residents can brighten their days at the Town Centre, a vibrant hub offering both indoor and outdoor dining experiences, carefully chosen retail outlets, and bustling markets. For those with an active lifestyle in mind, the Sports Village is the ideal place to exercise and stay fit.
 

Nima - The Valley by Emaar is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 370.0 million, at tender. Developed by Emaar Properties Pjsc. projects.name: Damac Casa Tower - Al Sufouh
projects.description:
This project involves the construction of a 2 basements and 46-story residence tower named Damac Casa in Dubai Media City, Al Sufouh, The tower boasts a wide range of living options, on levels 2 to 48, and residents can choose from luxurious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. For those seeking even more opulence, levels 49 to 58 offer exquisite 3, 4, and 5-bedroom ultra-luxury apartments.

The tower offers lap pools, a state-of-the-art boxing ring, a climbing wall, a jogging track, ethereal sky yoga spaces, and a luxurious spa. In addition, it is equipped with its own on-site emergency room to cater to any medical needs that may arise. Residents also have the convenience of a diet consultant and physiotherapist available on-site to support their health and wellness goals.

Situated in the Al Sufouh area with Dubai's iconic Palm as its backdrop, the tower captures the peacefulness of island living in every aspect of its design. Taking cues from the lotus flower, which thrives in aquatic surroundings, the tower aims to elevate residents' experiences with unmatched water vistas. The tower reimagines the concept of living on a vertical island, offering residents an extraordinary blend of water, tranquility, and luxury.

Damac Casa Tower - Al Sufouh is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at under construction (8.0 percent complete). Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc,Aqua Virdis Investment Llc. Lead consultant Killa Design,Ae7 Consultant (Dubai),Killa Design. Main contractor China Nuclear Industry 22Nd Construction Co. Ltd.. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The initiative also helps to mitigate the effects of climate change and encourages community members to get involved in preserving the environment. It will serve as a center for future mangrove science and research, restoration and conservation which can be sustained into the future. The project encompasses three meticulously designed zones: Asia, the Americas, and Eden Cafe. Visitors will embark on a remarkable journey as they explore lush tropical gardens, each inspired by the distinctive ecosystems found in Asia, Central, and South America.

Beyond the enchanting butterflies and insects native to these regions, the Eden Cafe promises a tranquil retreat with features like a cascading waterfall, a serene koi pond, graceful white peacocks, and even the opportunity to enjoy high tea in the company of butterflies.

At Butterfly Gardens Abu Dhabi, guests will have the extraordinary opportunity to observe butterflies in their natural habitat, freely interacting with visitors. The insect species will be thoughtfully presented in enclosures along the planned route, and pupa displays will offer a firsthand look at the captivating transformation of these creatures.

The gardens are destined to be a paradise for photographers, with plans to introduce photography classes in the future. A unique feature will be the ability to visit the gardens under a starlit night setting, allowing for evening visits.

The indoor facility will feature climate control, ensuring optimal conditions for both the flora and fauna while providing year-round comfort for visitors.

projects.name: Damac Lagoon Views - Damac Lagoons
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Aqua-themed apartment complex, named Damac Lagoon Views within the upcoming Damac Lagoons master community in Dubai. The Damac Lagoon Views will comprise one- and two-bedroom apartments spanning across ground plus six floors, complemented by various amenities that align with the community's Mediterranean theme.

Residents will have the chance to enjoy an array of relaxation and recreational activities. There will be beauty hills for sunbathing on small green mounds, a honey bar featuring wellness products, strategically placed hammocks over the lagoons, an outdoor spa, and an aqua boho lounge.

An olive tree garden will serve as an enchanting wedding venue amid a cozy event space, while the community's focal point will be the Flamenco Gardens concert stage. The project will feature a unique aqua opera school pavilion and a volcanic stone park. A beach club, glow lounge, board games pavilion, and a dedicated kids area will round out the entertainment offerings at Lagoon Views.

The gastronomy hub will provide diverse food and beverage experiences, including a tapas lounge, a pool bar, and a sunset beach bar. In harmony with the water theme of Damac Lagoons, the new project will captivate with its Lagoon Rain Party Zone and an innovative aquatic party venue. Fitness enthusiasts can look forward to an aqua gym equipped with a running track.

Damac Lagoon Views - Damac Lagoons is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at under construction (7.0 percent complete). Developed by Damac Crescent Properties Llc,Damac Properties Co. Llc. Lead consultant Jouzy Consulting Engineers (Axianta International); MEP consultant Jouzy Consulting Engineers (Axianta International). No contractor appointed. The project involves the construction of a Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Sheikh Khalifa Medical City. The project will enhance healthcare services for children, with more than 200 doctors equipped with the latest expertise delivering exceptional care to patients from across the UAE and around the world. These services include 29 specialities, among them oncology, ophthalmology, neurosurgery, liver, kidney, and bowel transplantation, gastroenterology, and cardiac medicine.

The CoE will have a capacity of 250 beds, including 10 beds for mental health services, and 100 beds for long-term paediatric healthcare. The centre will also work to advance research and innovation in the field of children's health to develop modern treatments and enhance therapeutic outcomes for children with complex health challenges.

For the housing grant category, the plan includes 606 homes in Al Yalayis, 432 homes in Wadi Al Amardi, 398 homes in Al Awir, 200 homes in the Makan area of Hatta, 120 homes in Oud Al Muteena, and 67 homes in Dubai’s rural and countryside areas.

Managed under the MBRGI umbrella, the Mothers’ Endowment campaign provides a platform for individuals to honor their mothers by making donations in their name to support underprivileged communities sustainably through education. projects.name: The Wilds by Aldaar
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Wilds, a premium residential community in Dubai. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, opposite Global Village, the development offers a nature-centric living experience with a strong emphasis on sustainability and wellness.

The Wilds will feature approximately 1,700 homes, including five- and six-bedroom mansions, three- to five-bedroom villas, and one- to three-bedroom apartments. Each residence is designed to integrate seamlessly with eco corridors and green spaces, providing privacy and a tranquil living environment.

As the first community in the UAE to achieve LEED Platinum and Fitwel 3-star certifications, The Wilds is committed to sustainability and wellness. The development incorporates a diverse natural habitat, including native plant species, ponds, dry stream habitats, duck houses, manmade bird nests, and bee-keeping zones to promote biodiversity.

A key highlight of the project is The Nest, a signature community pavilion serving as a visual landmark and a space for wildlife observation and environmental learning. Additionally, a premium international school will be part of the development, featuring outdoor learning spaces and eco-focused facilities to support environmental education.

The Wilds will also include a retail hub, clubhouses, a nursery, a clinic, and two mosques, ensuring residents have access to essential services. Recreational amenities such as fitness zones, tennis, padel, and basketball courts, wellness pavilions, meditation spaces, resort-style swimming pools, and walking/cycling trails will further enhance the community’s lifestyle offerings.

Designed to be family-centric, the development will feature interactive play areas, splash pads, shallow streams, and inclusive playgrounds for people of determination. Adventure seekers and nature lovers will find plenty of opportunities to explore and unwind within the thoughtfully designed landscape.

The Wilds by Aldaar is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 2000.0 million, at tender. Developed by Dubai Holding,Aldar Properties Pjsc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Dubai Mangroves
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a mangrove project in Dubai. Encompassing 72 kilometers of coastline, the project aims to plant over 100 million mangrove trees, positioning it as the world’s largest coastal regeneration endeavor and positioning Dubai as one of the most resilient cities by 2040. Its vast scale and visionary approach mark a significant step towards sustainable urban development, harmonizing the restoration of crucial mangrove ecosystems with the enhancement of urban areas. 

The initiative prioritizes mangroves for their exceptional capacity to sequester carbon, safeguard coastal regions from erosion, and sustain marine life and food security. With mangroves capable of absorbing approximately 12.3 kg of CO2 annually per tree, the entire project could sequester 1.23 million tonnes of CO2 each year, equivalent to eliminating the emissions of over 260,000 gasoline-powered passenger vehicles annually. Central to the project is the recognition of mangroves' indispensable role in preserving coastal ecologies, emphasizing their effectiveness in carbon sequestration, biodiversity support, and natural defense against climate change impacts such as erosion and sea level rise. This dedicated investment in mangroves responds to the urgent call for innovative and sustainable solutions to global environmental challenges, positioning Dubai as a trailblazer in coastal and urban ecosystem preservation.

The project also incorporates various edutainment assets, including the Mangrove Visitor Hub, designed to educate and engage the community and visitors on the significance of mangroves and broader environmental challenges. Together with the Botanical Museum and the Nature Reserve Conservation Center, these facilities will serve as hubs for research, education, and advocacy, fostering environmental stewardship among residents and tourists alike.

Dubai Mangroves stands as a testament to Dubai’s commitment to sustainable urban growth and environmental stewardship. By intertwining ecological conservation with the city’s developmental aspirations, the project not only aims to bolster Dubai’s coastal resilience but also to enrich its green infrastructure. This initiative reflects a profound understanding of the delicate balance between development and nature, underscoring Dubai’s leadership in shaping future cities that prioritize the health of their natural environments. The Dubai Mangroves project aims to establish a global standard, demonstrating that effective coastal regeneration is both essential and achievable for urban centers worldwide, ensuring a resilient and biodiverse future for generations to come.

Dubai Mangroves is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 500.0 million, at concept. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Kleindienst/RAK Customs & Port Department Floating Residences & Giga-Yacht
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of floating residences and a yacht in Ras Al Khaimah. The project consists of four distinct sections, first section, the 'Viking' section, will focus on designing and constructing a monumental 144-meter giga-yacht.

This giga-yacht construction will elevate Ras Al Khaimah to the elite ranks of the Netherlands, Germany, and Italy, as the fourth region globally capable of constructing giga-yachts, and the pioneering destination in the entire GCC region to achieve this feat. 

The second section of the shipyard encompasses the 'Coral Garden' area, which concentrates on constructing an unprecedented underwater living experience known as the Floating Seahorse Villas, a unique feature of The Heart of Europe project.

The third, 'Tug' section will focus on the construction of barges, supply vessels, and transportation vessels, with plans to more than double the Kleindienst Group's current fleet. Lastly, the 'Ferry' section will be dedicated to passenger transportation, fishing boats, as well as sailing and diving boats.

Kleindienst/RAK Customs & Port Department Floating Residences & Giga-Yacht is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 200.0 million, at concept. Each home is fully furnished by the renowned Tihany Design atelier, offering spacious interiors flooded with natural light. Private terraces provide stunning views of downtown Dubai or landscaped areas.

The project includes dedicated office space, family rooms, laundry facilities, and separate service entrances. Two exclusive penthouses, starting at 1,700 square meters, boast private swimming pools. Residents will enjoy access to a range of amenities on the 12th floor, including a lounge, terrace, gym, spa, golf simulator, and various meeting spaces.

projects.name: Ghamam - Jebel Deem
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a commercial building situated around 850 meters above sea level on Jebel Deem. It will offer stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, valleys, and coastline, aiming to redefine the tourism landscape in the region.

The first floor will feature a restaurant, an open cafe, and a reading room, providing visitors with a tranquil environment to relax and enjoy the scenic views. The ground floor will include viewing platforms, a multipurpose hall, and a prayer room to cater to various visitor needs. Over 4,500 trees, including olive, apple, pomegranate, and grape varieties, have been planted to enhance the rocky mountain landscape, creating a green oasis.

Additional nearby attractions include an open theatre and play areas for children, making the overall area a family-friendly destination. A football stadium, situated 650 meters above sea level, promises cooler and humidity-free playing conditions for sports enthusiasts. Additionally, a 100-room hotel will provide luxurious accommodation options for tourists visiting the vicinity.

The project involves the construction of two residential towers in City Walk, Dubai. The projects offer an exclusive collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments in two towers - Tower A (ground plus an additional 36 floors) and Tower B (ground plus an additional 28 floors), characterized by upscale interiors, lush landscaping, outdoor amenities, and awe-inspiring views, strategically located 10 minutes from Jumeirah Beach and 5 minutes from Downtown Dubai.

Featuring 427 units with 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom premium apartments, a 2-floor super penthouse, fully equipped kitchens, state-of-the-art amenities including a fitness center, cigar lounge, movie and games rooms, versatile multi-purpose space, stylish and sophisticated interiors, an infinity edge pool with Burj Khalifa views, a kids' pool area, viewing decks, and a lawn area for events. The project provides an unparalleled living experience in the heart of the city with easy access to premium retail, dining, leisure, and entertainment, including the Coca-Cola Arena, The Green Planet bio-dome, Roxy Cinema City Walk, Nowayout Escape Room, Alkhazzan Park, hotels, and the Canadian University Dubai.

projects.name: Bayz 102 Tower

The project involves the construction of 'Bayz 102 Tower,' a residential complex located in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. The tower spans 102 floors and features 956 apartments. The residential options include studios, 1-bedroom apartments, 1-bedroom apartments with a pool, 2-bedroom apartments with a pool, 3-bedroom apartments with a pool, and 4-bedroom apartments with a pool.

The property offers panoramic views of iconic Dubai landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, Jumeirah Beach, and the sea. Residents of this complex will enjoy over 40 world-class amenities such as landscaped gardens, a kids' outdoor pool, an outdoor swimming pool, a multipurpose hall, a yoga court, dining options, jogging trails, a sports court, a well-equipped gym and fitness center, covered parking and concierge service. The complex also ensures round-the-clock security and CCTV surveillance. With high-end finishes, fully furnished options featuring Italian Dolce Vita furniture, and a premier helipad for sky taxis and helicopters, it delivers a truly luxurious lifestyle.

Strategically located in Business Bay, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a short 6-minute drive away, while the Dubai Mall is conveniently situated just 9 minutes away. Dubai International Airport can be reached in approximately fifteen minutes, and the iconic Burj Khalifa is a mere 10-minute drive away. Access to Palm Jumeirah takes approximately 22 minutes by car. It also provides convenient access to Sheikh Zayed Road and the metro station.

The project involves the construction of residential towers at Dubailand, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The development, Verdes at Haven by Aldar, comprises seven residential buildings with floors ranging from 4 storeys to 17 storeys, offering luxurious apartments with high-end designs and various spaces for a comfortable and opulent lifestyle, including 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 2-bedroom duplexes. Each unit is crafted to provide a blend of sophistication and comfort, ensuring an exceptional living experience.

The project emphasizes wellbeing through biophilic design and holistic living, featuring seven towers across two plots with a total of 988 homes. These residences, comprising apartments, penthouses, and duplexes, are designed with curved architectural forms and natural materials to promote a tranquil living experience. The project boasts views of lush landscapes and water features, with designs that maximize daylight and minimize noise pollution.

Verdes by Haven offers a range of amenities to support a wellness-oriented lifestyle. Residents will have access to co-working spaces, a state-of-the-art gym, spa, and treatment rooms. The development also includes facilities for yoga and Pilates, a multipurpose room for events and activities, and 24/7 onsite maintenance. Various lifestyle services are available to enhance the living experience.

The project provides residents with additional facilities such as a meditation pavilion, zen gardens, tranquility pool, nature trail, exercise areas, and a padel tennis court. Through this comprehensive approach, Verdes by Haven aims to create a luxurious living environment that balances nature, community, and modern amenities, offering residents an elevated and wellness-focused lifestyle.

Residents will enjoy an array of elevated amenities, including a rooftop swimming pool, fully equipped gym, lounge and BBQ area, centrally air-conditioned children’s play zone, and an outdoor sun-sitting terrace. The development’s landscaped gardens and outdoor gathering spaces foster community interaction and relaxation. Strategically positioned minutes from IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village, with direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Estrella balances boutique exclusivity with effortless connectivity.

The first phase of Knightsbridge features a select array of 66 properties, including 4-bedroom townhouses and 5- and 6-bedroom villas, all exemplifying the pinnacle of luxury and sustainability. Highclere 4-Bedroom Townhouses: Ranging from 1,853 to 4,191 sq.ft in plot size and 3,937 to 3,971 sq.ft in built-up area, these townhouses are ideal for families. All residences at Knightsbridge are designed with luxury and convenience in mind, featuring private pools, fresh harvest gardens, private elevators, smart home systems, and climate-controlled outdoor shaded terraces. The villas further enhance the living experience with private jacuzzis, maid and driver’s rooms, chef and show kitchens, and a private cinema. The first phase encompasses a total plot area of 335,877 square feet, with 70% dedicated to green spaces. This pioneering development promises a unique living experience centered on wellness, luxury, and environmental harmony. Knightsbridge features bay-view popped-out windows, curved lines for optimal climate control, and a harmonious blend of yellow stone and metal cladding, making each home a masterpiece of design and sustainability. The project incorporates numerous sustainable features, including abundant green spaces, solar panels, a re-oxygenating waterfall, self-shading building terraces, a smart home system, EV charging stations, solar water heating, energy-efficient LED lighting, UV-proof double glazing, an insulated building envelope, a smart irrigation system, greywater recirculation with UV filters, and biodegradable reed-bed filtration for lake water. Residents will enjoy world-class amenities such as a lagoon, a running track, a Japanese Rapha Yoga deck, a Stargazing Tea Lounge, an outdoor cinema, and more. projects.name: Mira Coral Bay - Al Mairid - Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a mixed-use development in the Al Mairid area, Ras Al Khaimah offering a diverse array of high-end accommodations and amenities. The project will feature a 5-star branded spa hotel with 100 keys and a resort hotel boasting 250 rooms. For those seeking a more private retreat, the development will include six clusters of villas comprising 165 units, two clusters of townhouses with 128 units, and four clusters of apartments totaling 650 units.

At the heart of Mira Coral Bay will be a state-of-the-art yacht club and two exclusive branded beach clubs, catering to maritime enthusiasts and sun-seekers alike. Culinary aficionados will delight in the 10 premium branded restaurants scattered throughout the development. The mixed-use project will incorporate underground parking and scenic walkways, with a unique architectural design that seamlessly integrates the environment and outdoor facilities while prioritizing pedestrian comfort.

Situated just 10 minutes from Downtown Ras Al Khaimah, Mira Coral Bay will offer residents and visitors unparalleled access to the emirate's vibrant city life while providing a tranquil waterfront escape. This harmonious blend of urban convenience and natural beauty positions Mira Coral Bay as a grand jewel in the Al Mairid area, promising an unmatched living experience for those fortunate enough to call it home.

projects.name: Ellington Belgrove Residences - Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR)

The project involves the construction of a residential building in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. This development will feature a ground floor, four podium levels, 26 residential floors, and a rooftop. It offers a range of meticulously designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each tailored to deliver an exceptional living experience. The building’s elegant design, inspired by the gracefulness of flamingos, embodies a commitment to beauty, balance, and innovation.

The residence boasts amenities designed to enhance the lifestyle of its occupants. The entrance sets a welcoming tone, featuring a drop-off area and a lobby arcade that extends into a lobby with lounges, a reception area, a communal table, swings, and a library wall. Additional features include a rooftop observatory and an outdoor cinema, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The serene zone caters to family activities, with options for outdoor dining, flamingo-themed lounges, and picnic areas. The adults' zone offers a relaxing pool deck with sunken seating, while the kids' zone provides dedicated pools and play areas. A special pets zone is also available, complete with play and wash areas for pets.

Located in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City), the residence offers breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Its prime location ensures easy access to major landmarks: Burj Al Arab is just 22 minutes away, while Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are each a mere 10 minutes from the property. Dubai International Airport is a quick 9-minute drive, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) is reachable in 18 minutes. Palm Jumeirah is 28 minutes away, and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is just 6 minutes from the residence.

The project involves the construction of Selene Beach Residences by Sobha Group, a luxury residential development located on the pristine Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. This exclusive project offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 3-bedroom duplex apartments with a total of 546 units, all featuring modern architecture and breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and lush golf courses. Nestled in a natural paradise, the development provides a serene escape while being seamlessly connected to the mainland via a 1.7 km bridge, ensuring convenient access to key regions and attractions.

projects.name: Yas Riva by Aldar Properties - Yas Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the villas within Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. Offering both canal-front and canal-accessible homes designed to provide a serene waterfront lifestyle. The project includes 151 four-, five-, and six-bedroom canal-front and canal-accessible villas. Residents will enjoy a range of amenities, including a health and wellness center on the water’s edge, featuring a spa, gym, adults’ and kids’ pools, and a sunken firepit. The community is further enriched with landscaped gardens, three parks, and various recreational facilities, such as padel courts, outdoor fitness areas, and an amphitheater.

Uniquely positioned as one of Abu Dhabi’s few residential developments with direct canal access, Yas Riva features canal-front villas with private docks, enabling residents to explore the surrounding waterways by boat. The community’s design draws inspiration from the natural landscape, with the flowing curves of the villas mirroring the gentle movement of water. The minimalist design of these villas complements the lush greenery, creating a peaceful living environment.

Yas Riva is designed with sustainability in mind, targeting a 3 Pearl Estidama rating for the villas and a 2 Pearl Estidama rating for the overall community. The development incorporates sustainable practices to reduce carbon emissions and water usage, including the use of recycled materials and low-carbon construction methods. Additionally, Yas Riva is pursuing a 2-star Fitwel rating, aligning with global standards for promoting healthy communities.

Its structure is composed of two main elements—the platform and grandstand, shaped to resemble the undulating dunes of the surrounding desert.

The roof of the stadium, shaped like a bird with outstretched wings, changes color with the time of day, reflecting a silver hue in the morning and transitioning to a golden-red glow in the evening. The stadium is designed to fulfill all the necessary standards for hosting events and tournaments at local, regional, and international levels.

Residents will enjoy an array of dedicated amenities, including a breathtaking infinity pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a yoga and viewing deck, and exclusive lounges for social gatherings. projects.name: Sobha Elwood - Dubai Land

Key amenities include an amphitheater, communal gardens, a clubhouse, a basketball court, jogging tracks, and more. With over 10,000 trees and seven themed parks inspired by the world’s largest forests, the development promises an enhanced lifestyle in a lush, green environment. The community also includes essential amenities like a clinic, an on-site school, and EV charging solutions, promoting eco-conscious living.

Sobha Elwood offers 167 luxury 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, each thoughtfully crafted with expansive spaces, large windows, and earthy tones to blend seamlessly with the natural surroundings. The villas are modern interpretations of contemporary living, featuring open-plan layouts that prioritize functionality and a deep connection to nature. In addition to the serene residential experience, residents will enjoy exclusive access to two clubhouses, a community shopping center, and an array of sports and fitness facilities. The community is designed to promote wellness, with dedicated jogging and cycling tracks, skate parks, padel tennis courts, and therapeutic wellness areas.

Strategically located in Dubailand, Sobha Elwood offers quick access to major highways, ensuring seamless connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport. The development promises an unmatched living experience where luxury and nature converge, providing a rejuvenating environment with fresh air, lush greenery, and a wide range of recreational facilities. From the lap pool and splash pads to adventure trails and forest paths, this urban oasis invites residents to immerse themselves in the tranquility of The Canvas of Nature while enjoying all the conveniences of modern life.

The design philosophy combines classic elements with contemporary aesthetics, reflecting a mastery of form, function, and luxury.

Lavita at The Oasis features four distinct facade styles—Ayanna, Aman, Faya, and Naya—each bringing a unique architectural vision while maintaining a harmonious community aesthetic. The mansions are designed with meticulous attention to detail, using high-quality materials like polished marble, rich wood accents, glass, and metal to create an inviting and elegant ambiance. Beyond the opulent interiors, Lavita offers a range of amenities, including landscaped parks, jogging tracks, wellness centers, and luxury boutiques, ensuring that residents enjoy a well-rounded lifestyle within their private sanctuary.

Located in close proximity to major transportation routes such as Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road (D54) and the future extension of Al Khail Road (E44), Lavita provides a seamless connection to Dubai’s vibrant attractions while offering a peaceful retreat from the city’s fast pace. The development is part of The Oasis, an expansive 100 million square feet masterpiece that includes over 7,000 residences, with a focus on majestic super-mansions, mansions, and villas. Lavita combines luxury and serenity, providing a haven where privacy meets connectivity, and every moment offers a chance to relax and rejuvenate amidst a backdrop of stunning natural beauty.

projects.name: G42/Microsoft Two AI Centres
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of two artificial intelligence (AI) centers in Abu Dhabi. The first center will focus on identifying, developing, and advancing best practices and industry standards for the responsible use of AI in the Middle East and the Global South. It aims to bring together academic researchers and AI practitioners from the private sector to document and share emerging Responsible AI practices.

Additionally, the project will establish an 'AI for Good Research Lab'. The lab will support social goals such as enhancing food security and strengthening climate resilience. It will collaborate with nonprofit organizations and partners to tackle key economic and societal challenges across the Middle East and Africa. Working closely with its existing team in Nairobi, the lab will develop large language models (LLMs) for underrepresented languages, helping to bridge the global language divide. Furthermore, the lab will apply AI to high-resolution geospatial data to improve disaster preparedness and response capabilities while advancing food security and climate resilience.
